accessToken.description: Current opaque WhaleU access token; school management checks true current grants.

info.description: Unversioned pin commands preserve their original canonical scope. Explicit version 2 binds every pin, read and unpin command to spaceId. Related campuses keep independent slots for the same canonical post; current topology and public visibility are required for projection, pin and read. Exact own-slot unpin remains available after related distribution or Review withdrawal. Developers retain canonical and global scope only, never a new remote-related grant. Optional detail viewSpaceId selects the destination slot and returned spaceId; it is never inferred from display metadata. Receipts and original-key recovery remain unchanged.
info.title: WhaleU scoped post pins
